sections.title: Identity and range
sections.text: This catalogue ID uses the genus name Balanites; the illustrated and described plant is Balanites aegyptiaca, the desert date. It is a thorny evergreen small tree reaching about 15 m, widespread in tropical Africa and parts of the Near East. Its yellow fruit is roughly 2.3–4.7 cm long and contains fibrous pulp around a hard stone.

sections.title: Fruit and uses
sections.text: Kew records the fruit as edible, and the seed kernel is used for oil. These uses refer to B. aegyptiaca, not automatically to every species in the genus. The plate's thorny tree, compound leaves, small flowers and yellow fruits fit this identification.
